item.title: Operations Update: PJM Issues Capacity Advisory for Oct. 19
item.description: PJM has issued a Capacity Advisory for Monday, Oct. 19, ahead of expected tight system conditions due to equipment outages needed for maintenance and construction. The PJM load forecast is estimated at about 94,573 MW against expected generation outages of about 72,000 MW as well as planned transmission outages. A Capacity Advisory is a new […]

item.title: PJM Reviews September Hot Weather Operations
item.description: PJM and the PJM generation and transmission owners coordinated closely during two unseasonably warm September periods to reliably serve demand while managing tightening generation and transmission system constraints, PJM told the Operating Committee Thursday. item.title: PJM Issues Maximum Generation Alert for Oct. 13, Extends Capacity Advisory to Oct. 14
item.description: PJM has issued a Maximum Generation Alert and Load Management Alert for Oct. 13 ahead of expected tight system conditions caused by unusually warm fall weather and planned equipment outages required for maintenance and construction. This alert does not require any action from customers. PJM also has a Capacity Advisory in place for Oct. 12–14 […]
